backup_help_download: Generates a JSON file with all the database tables. Save it in a safe place.
backup_help_freq: Download a copy at least once a week, or before making important changes.
backup_help_restore: Upload a JSON backup file. Records that already exist will not be duplicated. Those that do not exist will be added.
help_energy_tariff_desc: Defines the daily vital basket (food, water, services) and effort factors. This is used to calculate fair prices for products and labor.
help_general_desc: Node name, currency name (e.g.: TQ, Barter units, Hours, Points) and application name.
help_member_levels_desc: Defines the types of individual user in the community. Each level has limits, rights (voice, vote, quorum) and permissions. Members with vote are part of the assembly. E.g.: new, active, honorary.
help_org_levels_desc: Defines the types of organization or business within the community. Each level has its own limits, taxes and permissions. Organizations are commercial/collective entities, not persons. E.g.: production, consumption, public, cooperative.
net_domain_and_key_required: Domain and public key are required
net_domain_or_ip_hint: Public domain or IP of this node. Configure it in the "General" tab.
net_federate_hint: To federate with another village: Use the Federate Villages tab in the Federation menu. There you can add the other village's data (domain, IPv6 ULA, WireGuard) to establish federation.
net_image_for_village_desc: Generate an OpenWrt image with the current configuration of this village.
net_image_need_internet: Internet connection (fiber, cable, ADSL, radio link)
net_image_need_mini_pc: Mini-PC x86_64 with 2 network cards (WAN + LAN)
net_image_need_usb: USB or disk to flash the image
net_image_new_village_desc: Generate a pre-configured image to deliver to another village. Includes new IPv6 ULA and WireGuard keys, pre-federated with this village.
net_inst_connect: Connect the village server: eth0 to Internet, eth1 to LAN
net_inst_flash: Flash with BalenaEtcher onto a USB or disk
net_inst_install_node: Install the application node on another server in the village
net_inst_power: Power on the server from the USB/disk
net_internet_desc: How to find you over the public Internet. Does not require OpenWrt.
net_intranet_desc: How to find you over the private intranet between villages using WireGuard. Does not use the public Internet — creates a parallel Internet between villages. Only applies if you have OpenWrt installed.
net_mode_hint: The node works without OpenWrt. Switch to Intranet when OpenWrt is installed.
net_my_info_desc: These are your node's network data. They serve so that other villages can find this node and know its services. This is not federation — it is your node's network registry. To federate with another village, use the Federate Villages tab.
net_no_openwrt: You do not have OpenWrt configured.
net_no_openwrt_hint: If you want to create a private intranet between villages (that works without public Internet), install OpenWrt using the OpenWrt Installer tab.
net_openwrt_hint: The internal node name does not change. OpenWrt only redirects the subdomain to the node.
net_public_domain_hint: More friendly domain if you have OpenWrt configured.
net_services_desc: Register village services in the OpenWrt DNS. Each service gets a subdomain with automatic SSL.
net_ula_hint: Unique prefix for the village. No collisions between villages.
net_village_ipv6_hint: Private address of your village within the intranet.
net_wg_endpoint_hint: Address and port to connect via WireGuard within the intranet.
net_wg_generate_keys_hint: Generate the keys with the button below.
net_wg_pubkey_hint: Key for the intranet WireGuard tunnel.
net_working_internet_desc: You can install OpenWrt later to have a federated private network between villages. The internal node name does not change. OpenWrt only redirects the subdomain.
settings_adaptations_page_desc: Catalog of producer communities and how the software adapts to each one
settings_additional_servers: additional server(s) with minimum 8GB RAM (ideally 16GB) to install YugabyteDB in multi-node mode.
settings_administrative_hint: 1.0 = base (basal metabolism + manual tools). Office work, management, administration.
settings_agricultural_hint: 0.61 = real metabolic consumption (~525 kcal/h). Manual agricultural work, construction, lifting. Sustained physical effort.
settings_alert_threshold_hint: Alert when tablet usage reaches this %
settings_app_name_hint: Name that users see in the interface.
settings_approval_queue: Received prohibitions will appear in the approval queue below.
settings_auto_backups_desc: The system can create automatic database backups and save them on the server. Configure how often to make them and how long to keep them before deleting. Locked backups are never automatically deleted.
settings_auto_credit: Automatically credit TQ when closing the cayapa
settings_auto_rotate_key: Automatically rotate key on each transaction (DESFire/NTAG424 only)
settings_backup_disabled_demo: Backup functions are disabled on the demo node.
settings_backup_requested: Backup requested. The service will create it in the next 60 seconds...
settings_backup_still_processing: The backup is still processing. Refresh in a few minutes to see it.
settings_biodynamic_desc: Agricultural planning based on Rudolf Steiner's biodynamic calendar. Root, flower, leaf and fruit days according to the moon's position in constellations. Useful for Camphill, Findhorn and other communities that practice biodynamic agriculture.
settings_biodynamic_notes_ph: Notes on the node's biodynamic practice
settings_cancel_failed: Could not cancel. The node and the updater-controller are not responding.
settings_cancel_sent_updater: Cancellation sent directly to the updater-controller.
settings_cannot_connect_both: Cannot connect to either the node or the updater-controller. Verify that the containers are running.
settings_cannot_start_update: Cannot start the update. Neither the node nor the updater-controller respond. Verify that the containers are running.
settings_card_type_config_desc: Configure which card types this node accepts. In Venezuela, standard cards (MIFARE Classic) are easier to obtain. Secure cards (DESFire EV3) offer protection against cloning.
settings_cayapa_attendance_desc: Configure how attendance is recorded for cayapas (community work sessions). You can use NFC (cryptographic cards), QR code (alternative without NFC), or both. When NFC is available, you can deactivate QR.
settings_cayapa_how_it_works: How it works: The coordinator opens check-in from the app. Participants register by tapping their NFC card or showing their QR code to the manager. When closing the cayapa, the system calculates hours and automatically credits TQ with the effort factor.
settings_change_energy_tariffs_desc: Propose changing the node's energy tariffs. This affects how the value of work is calculated in TQ.
settings_closed_message_hint: This message is shown when someone tries to transact outside permitted hours.
settings_closed_message_ph: E.g.: Transactions are closed for sabbath rest.
settings_commerce_hours_desc: Configure the hours when transactions are allowed on the node. You can block full days (e.g.: Saturday), time ranges, or windows that cross midnight (e.g.: Friday at sunset until Saturday at sunset).
settings_community_work_description: Register community work sessions (cayapas, mingas, volunteer work). Supports valuation in hours, TQ, or without valuation. Sessions may require approval to prevent unilateral inflation of credits.
settings_confirm_restart_node: Confirm that you want to restart the node?
settings_confirm_stop_node: Confirm that you want to stop the node?
settings_could_not_load_tariff: Could not load the energy tariff.
settings_could_not_verify_remote: Could not verify the remote repository.
settings_counts_quorum_title: Counts for the minimum number of members required to validate a vote
settings_currency_abbr_hint: Short abbreviation of the currency. Appears in balances, transfers and prices. E.g.: TQ for Barter, HR for Hour.
settings_currency_full_name_hint: Full name of the internal currency. E.g.: Barter, Hour, Point. Appears in explanatory texts and on the public site.
settings_days_per_month_hint: Work days per month. Typical: 20-24. With 22 days x 8 TQ/day = 176 TQ/month base income.
settings_db_functions_disabled_demo: Database functions are disabled on the demo node.
settings_default_rules: Base rules (e.g.: no meat, no alcohol)
settings_delete_backup_confirm: Delete this backup? This action cannot be undone.
settings_delete_node_confirm: Remove this node from the list? This does not stop the node on the remote server.
settings_demo_backup_readonly: This tab is read-only on the demo node. You cannot create, download or restore backups in demo mode.
settings_demo_database_readonly: This tab is read-only on the demo node. You cannot modify database nodes or download scripts in demo mode.
settings_demo_domain_hint: This domain is automatically inherited from the parent node. It cannot be modified. If the parent changes domain, this demo node will automatically update the next time it restarts.
settings_demo_functions_disabled: Demo node functions are disabled when you are inside the demo node.
settings_demo_login_desc: The demo node does not use normal username/password. Instead, it shows buttons with available roles:
settings_demo_login_password: Each button logs in directly with that role. Password: demo1234 for all.
settings_demo_manage_from_main: To manage the demo node, use the main node at http://localhost:8080
settings_demo_node_desc: You can modify the name, currency and other internal settings. The domain is locked because it is inherited from the parent node. Changes reset every 24h.
settings_demo_preset_desc: Choose the profile with which the demo will be initialized. Each profile loads different data, schedules and rules according to the community's philosophy.
settings_demo_reset_success: Demo node reset. Data is being recreated with the selected preset.
settings_demo_role_board: Board of Directors - president, vice president, treasurer, secretary, members
settings_demo_role_members: Members - farmers, producers, artisans, new member
settings_demo_role_orgs: Organizations - cooperative, bakery, workshop, store, health center
settings_demo_tab_readonly: This tab is read-only on the demo node. You cannot restart or configure the demo node from here in demo mode.
settings_description_hint: Explain what this level means. E.g.: Full member with all rights.
settings_description_ph: E.g.: Full member with all rights
settings_docdb_memory_desc: Percentage of RAM for YugabyteDB writes (global_memstore_size_percentage).
settings_domain_help_usage: Used for federation, public URLs and node identity. If you change the domain, all local data is preserved (nothing is lost). Make sure the new domain points to this server before saving.
settings_download_backup_desc: Download a JSON file with all the tables and data from the node's database. This includes: users, products, exchanges, public pages, configuration, etc. Save this file in a safe place.
settings_effort_factors_hint: Multiply the cost of work according to its physical or mental difficulty. 1.0 = base effort. Higher = harder = more pay.
settings_end_day_hint: The block goes from the start day at the start time until this day at the end time.
settings_federated_sharing_description: Federated nodes with the same profile share product prohibitions.
settings_food_hint: Energy to produce daily food (agroecological). E.g.: 3 kWh
settings_frne_desc: Fair exit: resolves how to non-speculatively liquidate the housing of a member who decides to leave the community, without decapitalizing the common fund. The member receives the value of their original contribution + improvements, but NOT the speculative value of the property (which belongs to the community).
settings_frne_formula: Total to pay = Original contribution + Value of improvements (valued by assembly). The speculative value is NOT paid. Methods: lump sum, installments, or transfer to a new member.
settings_has_voice_title: Can speak and give their opinion in assemblies
settings_has_vote_title: Can vote in assemblies. Members with vote are part of the assembly.
settings_hours_per_day_hint: Standard work hours per day. Typical: 6-8. With 8h and a basket of 8 kWh, the base rate is 1.0 TQ/hour.
settings_housing_hint: Amortized energy for housing and cooking. E.g.: 2 kWh
settings_instructions_1: Add a new node with the form above.
settings_instructions_3b: to the remote server (USB, scp, etc).
settings_instructions_6: The node will join the cluster automatically and data will replicate.
settings_instructions_7: Make sure ports 7100, 9100, 5433, 7000 are open on both servers.
settings_labor_params_hint: Define the standard work time. Used to calculate the hourly rate.
settings_last_update_cancelled: The last update was cancelled. Press Reset to retry.
settings_level_change_sent_assembly: Change request sent to the Assembly. Current parameters remain in effect until the Assembly approves the change.
settings_level_creation_sent_assembly: Creation request sent to the Assembly. The level will be created when the Assembly approves it.
settings_level_name_hint: Name of the member level. E.g.: full, honorary, new.
settings_level_number_hint: Select the hierarchy of the level. 1 = new member (no rights), 5 = active member (voice and vote), 10 = administrator. It is not the number of permissions, it is the hierarchy. Two levels can have the same number.
settings_max_members_hint: How many people can belong to an organization at this level. 0 = no limit.
settings_max_organizations_hint: How many organizations this member can create or belong to. 0 = no limit.
settings_member_levels_desc: Member levels define the types of
settings_member_levels_desc2: in the community. Each level has credit/debit limits, rights (voice, vote, quorum) and permissions. Members with vote are part of the assembly.
settings_member_levels_examples: Examples: new (recently admitted, no vote), active (with voice and vote), honorary (with voice but no vote).
settings_multi_mode_min_hint: In multi-node mode, minimum 2 (or 3 for high availability)
settings_multi_node_desc: Multiple servers. High availability. Each node on a different server.
settings_nfc_unified: NFC card management has been unified on the
settings_nfc_unified_desc: page. There you can register and provision cards of the 3 supported types:
settings_no_additional_nodes: There are no additional nodes configured. You are only using the main node.
settings_no_auto_backups: There are no automatic backups yet.
settings_no_bio_entries: There are no entries in the calendar. Add days manually or they will be generated automatically.
settings_no_faith_profiles: There are no faith profiles configured.
settings_no_frne_requests: There are no exit requests registered.
settings_no_logs_both_down: Cannot get logs. Neither the node nor the updater-controller respond.
settings_no_member_levels: There are no member levels configured.
settings_no_org_levels: There are no organization levels configured.
settings_no_permission_config: You do not have permission to change the configuration.
settings_no_permission_update: You do not have permission to update the node.
settings_no_rules: There are no rules configured. All transactions are allowed.
settings_no_sessions: There are no community work sessions registered.
settings_node_created_download_script: Node created. Download the script and run it on the remote server.
settings_node_day_hint: On node days, the land is not worked.
settings_node_down_via_updater: Node not responding. Verification done via updater-controller.
settings_node_not_responding_logs: Node not responding (status: ${result.status}). Cannot get logs via API.
settings_node_profile_description: The religious/philosophical profile of the node determines which products are allowed or prohibited for the entire node. Federated nodes with the same profile automatically share product prohibitions.
settings_node_restarting_normal: The node is restarting. This is normal during the update.
settings_node_stopped_use_start: The node is stopped, use Start
settings_node_up_to_date: The node is up to date (installed commit:
settings_node_updated_ok: Node updated successfully. Checking new version...
settings_org_credit_limit_hint: How much the organization can owe (negative). E.g.: -100000.
settings_org_debit_limit_hint: How much the organization can accumulate (positive). E.g.: 100000.
settings_org_description_hint: Explain what type of organizations belong to this level. E.g.: Manufactures or produces goods.
settings_org_description_ph: E.g.: Production organization. Manufactures or produces goods.
settings_org_level_name_hint: Name of the organization level. E.g.: org_production, org_consumption, org_public, org_cooperative.
settings_org_level_number_hint: Select the hierarchy of the level within organizations. 1 = basic level, 10 = maximum level. It is not the number of permissions, it is the hierarchy.
settings_org_levels_desc: Organization levels define the types of
settings_org_levels_desc2: within the community. An organization is like a company: it has members, its own taxes, limits and rules. Each level has its own tax rate and credit/debit limits.
settings_org_levels_examples: Examples: org_production (manufactures goods), org_consumption (distributes goods), org_public (non-profit, exempt), org_cooperative (shared ownership).
settings_org_levels_intro: Organization Levels = Companies, cooperatives, institutions (not persons).
settings_org_tax_hint: Tax percentage that applies to transactions of this organization. 0 = exempt (typical of public institutions). 2 = 2% of each transaction goes to the community fund.
settings_pending_approval_desc: This change is not saved directly. It will be sent as a proposal to the Assembly. Current parameters will remain in effect until the Assembly approves the change.
settings_pending_prohibitions_descriptio: These prohibitions were reported by federated nodes with your same profile. Review and approve or reject.
settings_product_prohibitions_descriptio: Define which foods and products are prohibited according to the community's beliefs. Members choose a profile when registering.
settings_profile_created_shared: Profile created and shared with federation
settings_profile_desc_ph: E.g.: Does not consume pork or alcohol
settings_profile_shared: The profile will be automatically shared with all federated nodes via gossip.
settings_profile_shared_description: When a node with your same profile marks a product as prohibited, you will receive it automatically.
settings_prohibition_added_shared: Prohibition added and shared with federation
settings_proposal_sent_assembly: Proposal sent to the Assembly. Changes will be applied when approved.
settings_proposal_sent_assembly_tariffs: Proposal sent to the Assembly. Tariffs will be applied when approved.
settings_public_pages_desc: Activate or deactivate the public pages of this node. Deactivated pages are not accessible and do not appear in the public menu.
settings_reconnect_failed: Could not reconnect after 120 seconds. Check status with: docker compose ps
settings_requires_assembly_desc: On save, a proposal will be created for the Assembly to decide.
settings_requires_assembly_short_desc: On save, a proposal will be created.
settings_reset_demo_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset the demo node
settings_reset_demo_confirm2: All demo data will be deleted and recreated.
settings_reset_demo_desc: You can reset the demo node manually at any time. This will delete all demo data and recreate it from scratch. Useful when there are system updates and you want the demo node to reflect the changes immediately.
settings_reset_failed: Could not reset the state. Neither the node nor the updater-controller respond.
settings_rest_desc: remains for the backend, frontend and the OS.
settings_restart_yugabyte_warning: After saving, you must restart YugabyteDB for changes to take effect. The flag
settings_restore_warning: Restoring will add records from the backup that do not already exist in the database. Existing records are not overwritten (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING). This is safe but does not replace current data. For a complete restoration, contact the system administrator.
settings_same_server_desc: Add a service in docker-compose.yml by copying yugabytedb2 with a different hostname and ports.
settings_schedule_system_hint: If activated, transactions are blocked according to the rules. If deactivated, everything is allowed.
settings_seed_bank_desc: The seed bank works with loans and returns: the farmer takes seeds, plants them, and at harvest returns the same quantity plus an additional percentage (e.g.: 20% more) so the bank grows communally.
settings_separate_server_desc: Install YugabyteDB on another server and join it with --join=NODE1_IP. Each server adds ~534 tablets.
settings_services_hint: Energy for basic services (health, transportation, communications). E.g.: 2 kWh
settings_single_node_desc: A single server. More efficient. Raises the tablet limit.
settings_state_reset_ok: State reset. You can now update again.
settings_tax_hint: Percentage deducted from each transaction that goes to the community fund. 0 = no tax. 2 = 2% of each transaction.
settings_technical_hint: 3.0 = triple energy. Specialized technical work with electrical tools: electricity, plumbing, mechanics. Metabolic + equipment.
settings_update_completed_log_above: Update completed. The full log is above.
settings_update_confirm_desc: The latest version will be downloaded from the repository, the Docker image will be rebuilt and the node will be restarted. This may take several minutes. During the update, the node will not be available.
settings_update_node_desc: Check if there is a new version of the node in the repository and update with one click. The code is downloaded, the Docker image is rebuilt and the node is restarted.
settings_update_started: Update started. The node will restart automatically.
settings_update_started_updater: Update started via updater-controller. The node will restart automatically.
settings_updater_working_bg: The updater-controller is still working in the background.
settings_vital_basket_hint: How much it costs for the minimum for a person to live a day. The sum of these values is the basis of all calculations.
settings_voice_vote_quorum_hint: Voice = can speak in assembly. Vote = can vote (part of the assembly). Quorum = counts toward the minimum number of members required to validate votes.
settings_waiting_updater: Waiting for the updater-controller to start the update...
settings_water_hint: Energy to pump and treat daily water. E.g.: 1 kWh
settings_yb_nodes_desc: YugabyteDB can run on multiple servers at the same time. Data is replicated across all nodes.
settings_yb_nodes_desc2: If one server goes down, the other nodes keep running and your data is safe.
settings_yb_nodes_how: Add a node from here, download the installation script, copy it to the other server and run it. The new node joins the cluster automatically.
software_adaptations_intro: The system adapts to any culture, religion, philosophy or form of organization. Each node is independent and maintains its own identity. Here we explain how.
software_adaptations_no_results: No communities found with that criteria.
software_adaptations_page_disabled_msg: This page has been disabled by the node administrator.
tariff_help_effort: Administrative = 1.0 (basal metabolism). Technical = 3.0 (metabolic + electrical tools). Agricultural = 0.61 (real metabolic consumption ~525 kcal/h).
tariff_help_how: The energy needed to keep a person alive per day is calculated (vital basket in kWh). Then it is divided by the work hours to get the hourly rate.
tariff_help_values: A person in an agroecological community needs ~8 kWh/day. With 8 hours of work, the base rate is 1.0/hour.
tariff_help_values_label: Real values (based on ICE Database, Agribalyse, Ecoinvent, Pimentel):
tariff_help_what: It is the basis for calculating fair prices. 1 kWh of embodied energy. Every product or service has a target price: the total energy it cost to produce.
tariff_help_who: The assembly. Changing these values affects all price calculations.
settings_desc: Choose how the portal header and navigation look.
